name: labeled valuation vector
loss_warning: none when prime labels and all heights are retained

name: labeled support
loss_warning: all positive heights are erased

name: Boolean valuation projection
loss_warning: height and multiplicity information are erased

name: labeled height profile
definition: map p to v_p(n) on the active support
loss_warning: none if labels and heights are exact

name: unlabeled height multiset
loss_warning: prime identities, residues, and arithmetic labels are erased

name: total valuation height
loss_warning: support, labels, and height distribution are erased

name: support cardinality
loss_warning: prime labels and all heights are erased

name: logarithmic mass functional
loss_warning: as an isolated scalar it reconstructs n arithmetically but does not preserve geometric neighborhood structure

name: divisor box
loss_warning: the box is exact only when side labels and lengths are retained

name: labeled face-incidence data
definition: which coordinates of a divisor point lie on lower or upper facets
loss_warning: interior depths may be erased

name: boundary-coordinate count
definition: number of coordinates of a divisor point on a facet
loss_warning: which primes realize the boundary coordinates is erased

name: margin-interior count
definition: number of divisor points at coordinate distance at least r from every facet
loss_warning: the count does not recover the box or labeled face structure

name: k-full valuation region
loss_warning: exact heights and labels beyond the lower bound are absent

name: squarefree kernel layer
definition: Boolean support encoded by rad(n) or mu^2(n)
loss_warning: higher valuation layers are erased

name: residue fiber
definition: set or weighted mass of valuation vectors mapping to a fixed class modulo q
loss_warning: many labeled vectors share a residue class

name: character phase profile
loss_warning: one character erases all directions in the kernel of the phase map

name: truncated valuation profile
definition: visible divisibility or heights restricted by d<=D or primes/powers below a threshold
loss_warning: large primes and deep powers beyond the visibility region are absent

name: aggregate divisibility pushforward
loss_warning: pointwise profiles, order, sign, and correlations are generally nonrecoverable

name: convolution decomposition polytope
loss_warning: size balance and analytic cancellation require extra weights and estimates

name: prime-axis local germ
definition: values f(p^a) or their formal series along one valuation coordinate
loss_warning: cross-prime dependence and global analytic continuation are absent
